{{External|rs}}
'''Herb patches''' are [[farming patches]] in which players can grow [[herb]]s. Currently, there are a total of 10 [[Herb patch#Herb patches|Herb patches]]. Herbs are primarily used in the [[Herblore]] skill. Most herb patches also have a [[compost bin]], a [[tool leprechaun]], an [[allotment]], and a [[Flower (patch)|flower patch]] nearby. All herbs take approximately 80 minutes to fully grow. Each patch requires one seed to begin growing that herb type. A [[seed dibber]] is required to plant a herb seed (unless the player has completed the farming subsection of [[Barbarian Training]]) and a [[spade]] to harvest herbs.

Unlike [[allotment]]s, there is no way to protect herbs from disease, except by using a disease-free patch. Players can check on herbs regularly and apply [[plant cure]] if necessary to save a diseased plant. Using the [[Lunar Spellbook]], players can also cure diseased plants with the spell [[Cure Plant]], and instantly check the status of all farming patches by casting the spell [[Geomancy]]. It is highly recommended to use [[ultracompost]] on valuable herb crops, as this will not only greatly decrease the risk of death, but also increase the minimum yield to 6 herbs per seed. Yield boosting equipment such as the [[magic secateurs]] is also highly recommended.

Similar to allotments, players may increase harvesting speed over the automatic rate by harvesting, waiting 2 game ticks, then clicking again to harvest. This will harvest 2 herbs per animation, effectively doubling harvest rate for the patch. The increased speed can also be achieved without any need for precise timing by spam-clicking during the first two ticks of harvesting.

==Bonuses==
Many herb patches possess unique bonuses either after unlocking or once a requirement is fulfilled:
*10% increased experience using the patch south of [[Falador]] after completing the [[Falador Diary#Medium|Medium Falador Diary]].
*5, 10, and 15% extra yield using the patch north of [[Catherby]] with completion of the [[Kandarin Diary#Medium|Medium]], [[Kandarin Diary#Hard|Hard]], and [[Kandarin Diary#Elite|Elite Kandarin diaries]] respectively.
*5% extra yield using the patch in the second tier of the [[Farming Guild]] with completion of the [[Kourend & Kebos Diary|Hard Kourend & Kebos Diary]].
*5% extra yield using the patch in [[Hosidius]] with completion of the [[Kourend & Kebos Diary#Hard|Hard Kourend & Kebos Diary]].
*10% extra yield on all herb patches when wielding or having [[magic secateurs]] in the inventory.
*5% extra yield on all herb patches when wearing a [[Farming cape]].
*5% extra chance to save a [[Farming#Variable crop yield|harvest life]] on all herb patches with a planted [[attas seed]].{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1199288075186294784|date=26 November 2019|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/105451|archivedate=25 May 2020|quote=Percentage reduction on losing a life at each roll - specifically 5%.}}
*Disease-free patches in [[Troll Stronghold]] and [[Weiss]] unlocked with [[My Arm's Big Adventure]] and [[Making Friends with My Arm]] respectively.
*Disease-free patch in [[Hosidius]] with completion of the [[Kourend & Kebos Diary#Easy|Easy Kourend & Kebos Diary]].
*Disease-free patch near [[Civitas illa Fortis]] upon reaching Champion rank at the [[Fortis Colosseum]].
*Disease-free patch on [[Harmony Island]] with completion of the [[Morytania Diary#Elite|Elite Morytania Diary]].

==Trivia==
[[File:Geomancy Harmony Island patch protection.png|right|Harmony Island patch protection icon]]
[[File:Friends List.png|right|Hosidius patch protection icon]]
* [[Lunar spellbook]]'s [[Geomancy]] spell has custom descriptions for protected patches:
** Harmony Island's patch is described as being "permanently undead" and is indicated by a zombie variant of the [[Friends List]] icon.
** Hosidius's patch is described as being protected by the "people of Hosidius" and is indicated by the [[Friends List]] icon.
** Troll Stronghold and Weiss's patches use the generic protection description and icon.
** Civitas illa Fortis has no custom description nor icon at all.
